items.title: PLASA Awards for Innovation 2026 winners announced
items.summary: PLASA has announced the winners of its 2026 Awards for Innovation at PLASA Show London, recognising new lighting and stage technology for safety, efficiency and performance gains.

items.title: Measuring Good Design
items.summary: An industry essay questions how illuminated architecture's value and quality should be assessed, raising the ongoing debate over metrics for evaluating good lighting design beyond energy or compliance figures.
